description: Reply to an X (Twitter) post from the brand's connected X account. PRO plan and above. Pass the tweet URL or id. By default publishes immediately; use postType 'scheduled' (+scheduledAt) or 'queue' (draft).

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

postType.description: 'now' (default, publishes immediately), 'scheduled' (requires scheduledAt), or 'queue' (save as draft)

postingAccountId.description: X account to reply from, when the brand has more than one (id from check_social_accounts). Omit to use the brand's default.

replyTo.description: The X (Twitter) tweet URL (x.com/twitter.com) or bare numeric tweet id to reply to

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO 8601 UTC datetime, required when postType is 'scheduled'

name: reply_to_x_post
